# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and managed perf ports** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot-path colour and interop helpers to managed C# for speed. This release ports colour conversion, premultiplication, and HarfBuzz text-shaping helpers to allocation-free managed code, fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData, and adds .NET 11 WASM exception-handling support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m151, folding in several rounds of upstream bug fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## API Surface

- **Colour and interop perf ported to managed code** — Ports SKColor to SKColorF conversion, single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, and SKColor hex parsing to managed math, adding ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and removing round-trips through native code. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **HarfBuzzSharp allocation-free hot paths** — Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free with pooled UTF-8 encoding, removes per-call char[4] allocations in Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, and reads SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed** — Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions, simplifying consumption from safe contexts. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak fixed** — Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI). ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression introduced by the Skia update. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WASM exception handling** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions early. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes HarfBuzzSharp to 14.2.1, bringing the allocation-free Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse performance ports along with it.
